description: Every post of the account, scheduled or sent, the web app's included: newest first; page with `cursor` = the previous `next_cursor` while `has_more`. `source: "api"` posts carry the `id` `get_post_status` and `cancel_post` take, `status` as last read (`get_post_status` refreshes it); `source: "web"` posts have no `id` and are changed in the web app. 403 `insufficient_scope` = the user's connection lacks the `social:publish` permission: not a bad `video_id` or `account_id`, and a retry cannot fix it. Tell them to disconnect and reconnect aicut at https://www.aicut.pro/account/settings#connections (the full steps are in `prepare_post`'s REFUSALS), then STOP.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: list_posts
title: List the account's posts
